head: Edit the FIRST image as a strict pixel-registered 1024x1024 UNLIT BASE-COLOR texture projection guide. The SECOND image is design/material reference only, showing the opposite side of the same undead unicorn. Keep the first image camera, framing, silhouette, all geometry edges, exact horn/skull/hair/ornament positions, and flat medium-gray background unchanged. Do NOT reconstruct, move, add, remove or straighten any shape. Refine only surface color detail of the visible horse-skull face and its existing horn, rings and hanging charms. Add crisp weathered ivory grain and fine natural cracks on the existing skull surface, dark recessed details matching its current eye socket shape, aged dark iron with worn pale edges and thin restrained red fissures on the existing horn and rings. Preserve the dark hair and the saddle/body/background. The target is believable bone, iron and charcoal materials with fine texture variation matching the reference; no new light source, no strong painted shadows or reflections, no bloom, no text, no painted extra chains/teeth/holes. Preserve all existing color boundaries, especially skull silhouette. This is a base color texture for later projection to exactly this 3D mesh, not a new illustration.
saddle: Edit the FIRST image as a pixel-registered square UNLIT BASE-COLOR texture projection guide of the saddle and tack on an undead unicorn. The SECOND image is design/material reference ONLY. Preserve FIRST image's exact camera, framing, silhouette and every existing surface boundary: saddle seat and raised rim, the curved central strap, chains, three hanging skulls, ribbons, hair and background all stay in exactly the same normalized pixel locations. Do not invent/move/add/remove geometry, studs, chain links or ornaments. Sharpen surface texture on existing geometry: cracked charcoal leather with fine grain on the saddle seat and straps, worn silver-dark-iron edges and restrained aged bronze patina on existing harness hardware, pale weathered ivory fine cracks on the three existing skulls. Replace blurry mottled olive patches with coherent believable bone/leather/metal colors matching the reference. Keep all surrounding hair/body, red accents and flat gray background unchanged. No new shadows, lighting, perspective, bloom, lettering or new shapes. This guide will be projected directly onto exactly the same mesh: registered object edges matter more than decorative detail. Base color only, not a beauty render.
scope: Fixed-view base-color projection candidates; generated edits require registration/visibility review; no geometry or PBR inference.
